items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) against contribution notice
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe;
items.computation: Letter dated 21.05.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is given, so the letter date is the posting day. Sender is a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: a posted letter (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025) is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, and for this type of body that delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. 21.05.2026 + 4 days = 25.05.2026 (Monday) = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number one month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 25.05.2026 + 1 month = 25.06.2026 (Thursday). Not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday (Corpus Christi 2026 falls on 04.06.2026), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. Final deadline: 25.06.2026.

items.title: First monthly contribution debited by direct debit
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Voluntary membership and thus contribution liability start 01.06.2026. Contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the month they cover, so the June 2026 contribution is debited on 15.07.2026 (Wednesday), which is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in NRW, so no adjustment is needed. This is the first of a recurring monthly debit on the 15th of each following month.
